featured.title: Apple opens Foundation Models to developers free at WWDC 2026
featured.excerpt: At its 2026 Platforms State of the Union, Apple removed the cost barrier to on-device AI: free Foundation Models on Private Cloud Compute, image input, third-party model calls via Swift, and an open-source pledge.
featured.tldr: Apple gave developers with under two million first-time downloads free access to Foundation Models on Private Cloud Compute, added image input and server-side calls to Claude and Gemini through Swift, and confirmed the framework goes open source this summer.

sources.label: MacRumors — Apple AI and developer tool updates

latest.title: Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK brings MCP and sub-agents to TypeScript and Python
latest.excerpt: A supported TypeScript and Python toolchain wires native Model Context Protocol servers and sub-agents directly into Claude Sonnet and Opus.
latest.tldr: Anthropic packaged the patterns teams were hand-rolling into a native SDK for building multi-tool, multi-step agents on Claude.

latest.title: OpenAI ships three real-time audio models for voice agents
latest.excerpt: Purpose-built models for conversational agents, live translation, and transcription push voice from a feature toward core agent infrastructure.
latest.tldr: OpenAI split voice into three specialized real-time models, signalling that audio is now production infrastructure for agents.

latest.title: OpenAI models and Codex now run on Oracle Universal Credits
latest.excerpt: OCI customers can access OpenAI frontier models and Codex through credits they already hold, removing a separate procurement channel.
latest.tldr: OpenAI folded its models and Codex into Oracle Universal Credits, collapsing enterprise procurement friction.

latest.title: Gemini 3.5 Pro still not GA a month after Google's I/O promise
latest.excerpt: Google's flagship reasoning model with a two-million-token context and Deep Think mode stays in preview, even as the cheaper Flash tier ships.
latest.tldr: Gemini 3.5 Flash is generally available and the default in Search, while the flagship Pro tier remains gated in preview.
